req.title: Player deletion persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall remove the row from the players table so GET returns 404 afterwards.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that DELETE /players/{squadNumber} must remove the row from the players table so that a subsequent GET returns 404. The endpoint is DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing player returns 204 and subsequent GET by squad number returns 404; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent player returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — delete the lowest squad number (1) and highest (26) to catch off-by-one mutations; (4) STC — full state transition: player exists → DELETE → 204 → GET returns 404 (persistence verified); (5) DT — delete already-deleted player returns 404 (idempotency / double-delete). All tests use exact status code assertions and verify both sides of the existence check.

expected: Subsequent GET returns HTTP 404 Not Found

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_get_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_get_returns_404()

tests.name: test_delete_persists_state_transition_exists_to_gone
preconditions: Player with squad_number=7 (de Paul) exists in the database
trace: R-PLAYER-021: state transition present->absent; persistence verified via GET
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_persists_state_transition_exists_to_gone():
    client = TestClient(app)
    pre = client.get('/players/squadnumber/7')
    assert pre.status_code == 200
    assert pre.json()['squadNumber'] == 7
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/7')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    post = client.get('/players/squadnumber/7')
    assert post.status_code == 404

test_delete_persists_state_transition_exists_to_gone()

tests.name: test_delete_does_not_affect_other_players
expected: GET squad_number=10 returns 200 and squadNumber equals 10
trace: R-PLAYER-021: deletion of one row must not affect adjacent rows; EP partition isolation
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_does_not_affect_other_players():
    client = TestClient(app)
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/9')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    gone = client.get('/players/squadnumber/9')
    assert gone.status_code == 404
    still_there = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert still_there.status_code == 200
    assert still_there.json()['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert still_there.json()['lastName'] == 'Messi'

test_delete_does_not_affect_other_players()
